name: Call to Arms

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you help secure Hammerfall's foothold in the Eastern Kingdoms by driving back the aggressive Boulderfist ogres.
As an orc, you have a personal stake in Hammerfall, named for Warchief Orgrim Doomhammer, and in driving out the rival brutes threatening this memorial stronghold.
As a warrior, you face a direct test of endurance and honor against brute force and arcane power.
As a mage, you face Boulderfist Magi who wield arcane energies for destructive ends.

faq.answer: Drum Fel, an officer at Hammerfall in the northeastern Arathi Highlands, gives the call. He sends proven fighters against dangerous foes to protect the outpost and test their strength.
faq.q: Who gives the Call to Arms quest?

faq.answer: The Boulderfist lair lies southwest of Hammerfall, along the way to Thandol Span, the dwarven bridge to the Wetlands. Brutes and magi gather in earthen dens and mounds in the highlands.
faq.q: Where is the Boulderfist lair located?

faq.answer: Drum Fel calls for ten Boulderfist Brutes and four Boulderfist Magi to be defeated before returning to Hammerfall. Brutes attack at close range, while magi cast arcane spells from afar.
faq.q: Which enemies need to be defeated for this task?

faq.answer: The Boulderfists have dug in across Arathi and repeatedly challenged Hammerfall's Horde garrison. Their position near routes to the southern dwarven bridge threatens Horde scouting and supply lines, so Drum Fel wants their strength contained.
faq.q: Why are the Boulderfist ogres considered a threat to Hammerfall?

faq.answer: Drum Fel expects his fighters to return alive after succeeding, but honors those who fall fighting valiantly against formidable foes. Facing the ogres with tenacity and fearlessness brings honor, whether a warrior survives or not.
faq.q: What does Drum Fel mean by returning in body or in spirit?

aliases: is call to arms horde only
faq.answer: No. Drum Fel gives this call only to the Horde at Hammerfall. Alliance forces operate from Refuge Pointe to the west and regard Hammerfall's defenders and the Boulderfist ogres as hostile rivals for control of the Arathi Highlands.
faq.q: Can Alliance players undertake this quest?

faq.answer: The brutes form the front line and absorb blows, while the magi attack from the rear with destructive magic. Defeating both kinds weakens the Boulderfists' combined strength and keeps them from mounting an organized counterattack against Hammerfall.
faq.q: Why does Drum Fel target both brutes and magi?

sections.body: At Hammerfall, Drum Fel calls on travelers who have aided the outpost to face a real threat. Boulderfist ogres have harassed the Horde expedition and tested its defenders. Fel sends warriors against these foes, not minor skirmishers. He expects them to return alive or with honor, and promises praise for their tenacity in battle.
sections.title: A Test of Mettle

sections.body: Southwest of Hammerfall, the Boulderfist clan has dug in near the dwarven bridge between Arathi and the Wetlands. Brutes fight alongside cunning magi, bringing crushing strength and deadly magic. Their aggression threatens Horde supply lines and control of the region. Drum Fel orders warriors to defeat ten Boulderfist brutes and four magi. Their defeat will weaken the clan and show that Hammerfall will not yield ground or tolerate rivals in Arathi.
sections.title: The Boulderfist Threat

summary: At Hammerfall, Drum Fel sends proven warriors against the Boulderfist ogres. Their attacks threaten the Horde's foothold in Arathi.
